created: Done, the observation is open and the company can now see it.
answered: Done, the answer was recorded. The auditor will review it.
returned: Done, the observation is open again.
closed_locked: This observation is already closed: it cannot be changed or reopened. If something else is needed, create a new one.
not_open: This observation was already answered: only an open observation can be answered.
invalid_transition: Only an observation the company already answered can be closed or returned.
